verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server lets users (including via Cursor, a dev tool) 'move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM' and update statuses/organize requests, which loosely supports pulling approved items into a delivery context, but there's no explicit evidence of exporting specs to issue trackers (Jira/Linear/GitHub) or a structured handoff to implementation. Missing for 10: explicit dev-tool/ticket-system integration, evidence of 'specification' artifacts, and confirmation this covers starting implementation rather than just idea management.
